system.description: These silver balls are inscribed with the twin-tailed comet of Sigmar and have been blessed by a priest. They will surely fly true and strike down the enemies of Sigmar! Encumbrance: Trivial individually; 1 altogether. When fired from a black powder weapon, this shot increases the Pierce value of the weapon by 1.
